en.headline: sogeisetsu ships meld-deepresearch CLI and adds discussion tracking
en.summary: sogeisetsu made **4 own commits** across two repositories on 2026-10-07, with 7 additional automated commits by `github-actions[bot]` in `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`. In `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch`, two commits landed: one added a thin `meld.py` CLI and converged docs onto it (phase 1), and another lightened the skill by cutting prose, adding a `--fix` flag, and downgrading two gate codes (phase 2). In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, two own commits updated `AGENTS.md` to require code changes go through branches, and added Discussions collection and display covering started, commented, and others' replies. On the issues side, the user commented on `anomalyco/opencode` issue `#50878`, which reports that after removing `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` the model still returns usable and is not removed from the model list. The user also started discussion `#4502` in `openchamber/openchamber` titled "Store relay identity keys encrypted at rest, and keep them out of settings.json backups", and received 2 replies from `btriapitsyn` on that discussion. No pull requests, reviews, or releases were recorded for the day.

zh.headline: sogeisetsu 发布 meld-deepresearch CLI 并新增讨论追踪
zh.summary: 2026-10-07，sogeisetsu 在两个仓库中提交了 **4 次本人提交**，另有 7 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交，均位于 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`。在 `sogeisetsu/meld-deepresearch` 中，两次提交分别新增了精简的 `meld.py` CLI 并将文档统一到该入口（phase 1），以及精简 skill 的说明文字、新增 `--fix` 参数并下调两个 gate 代码（phase 2）。在 `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 中，两次本人提交更新了 `AGENTS.md`，新增「代码修改必须走分支」的约束，并新增了 Discussions 采集与展示功能，覆盖发起、评论以及他人回复。Issue 方面，用户在 `anomalyco/opencode` 的 `#50878` 上留言，该 issue 反映删除 `~/.local/share/opencode/auth.json` 后模型仍可用且未从模型列表中移除。用户还在 `openchamber/openchamber` 发起了讨论 `#4502`，标题为「Store relay identity keys encrypted at rest, and keep them out of settings.json backups」，并收到 `btriapitsyn` 在该讨论中的 2 条回复。当日没有 PR、review 或 release 记录。
